title: FFT Companion
description: Final Fantasy Tactics game data across the PSX, War of the Lions and Ivalice Chronicles releases
summary: Final Fantasy Tactics game data across the PSX, War of the Lions and Ivalice Chronicles releases
offersHint: Final Fantasy Tactics game data across the PSX, War of the Lions and Ivalice Chronicles releases · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.fftcompanion.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_versions
toolsPreview.description: Lists the three Final Fantasy Tactics releases covered by this server and how many records exist per entity kind in each. Call this first to pick a version.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Finds entities by name or id across equipment, abilities, jobs, monsters, bosses, locations and consumables. Returns ids and display names only — use get_records or a specific data tool to retrieve the actual data. Matches English, Japanese and Portuguese names, and is punctuation-insensitive.

toolsPreview.name: get_records
toolsPreview.description: Returns complete records for up to 25 ids of one entity kind, including stats, costs, effects and availability with all cross-references resolved to names. Free while this deployment runs unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: query_equipment
toolsPreview.description: Filters and sorts the equipment table — by category, weapon/armor type, cost, and stat thresholds. Use this instead of paging through get_records when shopping for "best X under Y gil". Free while this deployment runs unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: find_item_sources
toolsPreview.description: Reverse lookup: every way to obtain a piece of equipment or a consumable — which outfitter unlocks it and after which battle, which monsters poach into it, and which treasure tiles hold it. This is indexed backwards from the game data and is not readable from the item record alone. Free while this deployment runs unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: get_job
toolsPreview.description: Full job record: raw stat multipliers and growth, static move/jump/evasion, the complete learnable ability set with JP costs, and which equipment types the job can equip. Also returns the version's stat ceilings for normalization. Free while this deployment runs unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: get_monster
toolsPreview.description: Full monster record: stat multipliers and growth by rank, poach drops (common and rare), ability set, and the random-battle locations it appears in per chapter — including which map you must travel from. Free while this deployment runs unmetered.

toolsPreview.name: compare_versions
toolsPreview.description: Compares the same entity across psx, wotl and ic and reports exactly which fields changed. Answers questions like "was this weapon nerfed in War of the Lions?" or "did Ivalice Chronicles lift the female-only restriction?" that otherwise require holding three datasets side by side. Free while this deployment runs unmetered.
